page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is an x86_64 instance built on an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor clocked at 2.3 GHz. The configuration provides 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, supported by a 504 MB L3 cache. It incorporates 186 GB of system RAM, allocating approximately 7.75 GB per vCPU. Attached local storage consists of 1343 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD capacity partitioned across 4 drives, while discrete GPU accelerators are not present.

The underlying Intel CPU features instruction set extensions including Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX tile and int8) and AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16 support, along with cryptographic acceleration via VAES and SHA_NI. In performance benchmarks, the instance achieves top-tier single-threaded compression throughput with a gzip rate of 36.68 GB/sec and a Geekbench single-core score of 2321.0. Multi-core performance is strong, highlighted by a Geekbench multi-core score of 16159.0 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 177.57 GB/sec. Small-model LLM inference tests record prompt processing at 2400.47 tokens per second and text generation at 394.37 tokens per second for 135M models.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio and local NVMe storage provide strong resource density for data-heavy applications, trading away GPU availability in favor of raw RAM capacity and fast host-attached disk IO. The hardware profile and benchmark results make this server type suitable for in-memory databases, caching layers, high-throughput web serving, software compilation, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
